grammar.pattern: 不仅 / 不光…，还 / 而且…
grammar.explanation: 不仅有阅读，而且有听力 states both features. 不光 introduces a similar addition, often conversational. The addition does not cancel the first claim; do not infer absent benefits.

examples.zh: 不仅有阅读，而且有听力。
examples.py: bù jǐn yǒu yuè dú , ér qiě yǒu tīng lì .
examples.en: There is reading and also listening.

examples.zh: 她不光看课程，还问了学费。
examples.py: tā bù guāng kàn kè chéng , hái wèn le xué fèi .
examples.en: She looked at courses and also asked tuition.

examples.zh: 不只是面积，还要看内容。
examples.py: bù zhǐ shì miàn jī , hái yào kàn nèi róng .
examples.en: Look at content as well as area.

commonMistakes.wrong: 不仅有阅读，所以没有听力。
commonMistakes.right: 不仅有阅读，而且有听力。
commonMistakes.why: The added feature is included, not denied.

grammar.explanation: 不是这门，就是那门 frames a limited alternative: one or the other. It does not by itself tell which was chosen. Distinguish 不是A而是B which explicitly rejects A and selects B. The speaker’s framing need not exhaust all real-world options.

examples.py: bù shì zhè mén , jiù shì nà mén .
examples.en: It is either this course or that one.

examples.zh: 她周末不是读书，就是听课。
examples.py: tā zhōu mò bù shì dú shū , jiù shì tīng kè .
examples.en: On weekends she either reads or listens to a class.

examples.zh: 不是周六，就是周日，具体还没定。
examples.py: bù shì zhōu liù , jiù shì zhōu rì , jù tǐ hái méi dìng .
examples.en: Either Saturday or Sunday; the exact day is undecided.

commonMistakes.wrong: 不是这门就是那门，说明已经选这门。
commonMistakes.right: 这句话还没说明选了哪门。
commonMistakes.why: Alternatives are not a completed choice.

lines.zh: 你留学的材料准备好了吗？
lines.py: nǐ liú xué de cái liào zhǔn bèi hǎo le ma ?
lines.en: Have you prepared your study-abroad documents?
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 差不多了。现在最难的是选专业。
lines.py: chà bu duō le . xiàn zài zuì nán de shì xuǎn zhuān yè .
lines.en: Almost. The hardest part now is choosing a subject.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 你不是想学中文吗？
lines.py: nǐ bù shì xiǎng xué zhōng wén ma ?
lines.en: Didn't you want to study Chinese?
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 对，但我也想学设计。中文系的课不仅多，还要写很多作业。
lines.py: duì , dàn wǒ yě xiǎng xué shè jì . zhōng wén xì de kè bù jǐn duō , hái yào xiě hěn duō zuò yè .
lines.en: Yes, but I also want to study design. The Chinese department has lots of classes and a lot of written work.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 能把两个专业结合起来吗？
lines.py: néng bǎ liǎng gè zhuān yè jié hé qǐ lái ma ?
lines.en: Could you combine the two subjects?
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 我问过老师，可以先学中文，再选几门设计课。
lines.py: wǒ wèn guò lǎo shī , kě yǐ xiān xué zhōng wén , zài xuǎn jǐ mén shè jì kè .
lines.en: I asked a teacher. I can start with Chinese and take a few design classes later.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 那学费会增加吗？
lines.py: nà xué fèi huì zēng jiā ma ?
lines.en: Would the tuition go up?
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 不会。但是我刚过去，可能需要时间适应。
lines.py: bù huì . dàn shì wǒ gāng guò qù , kě néng xū yào shí jiān shì yìng .
lines.en: No, but I'll probably need time to settle in when I first arrive.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 你现在不是上班就是上课，确实够忙的。
lines.py: nǐ xiàn zài bù shì shàng bān jiù shì shàng kè , què shí gòu máng de .
lines.en: You're always either working or in class now. You really are busy.
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 所以我想先少选一点。有空再和同学交流，别每天只赶作业。
lines.py: suǒ yǐ wǒ xiǎng xiān shǎo xuǎn yī diǎn . yǒu kōng zài hé tóng xué jiāo liú , bié měi tiān zhǐ gǎn zuò yè .
lines.en: That's why I want to take fewer classes at first, and have time to talk with classmates rather than just rush through assignments.
lines.speaker: b

reading.title: An option is not a decision
reading.blurb: An original scene written for this course.
reading.purpose: Follow the situation, the problem and what happens next.

lines.zh: 到新的学校以后，我本来想把每个晚上都安排成学习时间。周一和周三上中文课，周二和周四去设计室，周五参加交流活动。
lines.py: dào xīn de xué xiào yǐ hòu , wǒ běn lái xiǎng bǎ měi gè wǎn shang dōu ān pái chéng xué xí shí jiān . zhōu yī hé zhōu sān shàng zhōng wén kè , zhōu èr hé zhōu sì qù shè jì shì , zhōu wǔ cān jiā jiāo liú huó dòng .
lines.en: When I arrived at my new school, I initially planned to study every evening: Chinese on Mondays and Wednesdays, the design studio on Tuesdays and Thursdays, and an exchange event on Fridays.

lines.zh: 第一周，我不是在教室就是在路上。回到住处已经很晚，连朋友发来的消息都没有时间看。
lines.py: dì yī zhōu , wǒ bù shì zài jiào shì jiù shì zài lù shàng . huí dào zhù chù yǐ jīng hěn wǎn , lián péng you fā lái de xiāo xī dōu méi yǒu shí jiān kàn .
lines.en: In the first week I was either in a classroom or on the road. I got home so late I didn't even have time to read friends' messages.

lines.zh: 后来，老师让我写下自己真正想做的事。我想不仅看懂外文材料，还能和同学讨论自己的作品。
lines.py: hòu lái , lǎo shī ràng wǒ xiě xià zì jǐ zhēn zhèng xiǎng zuò de shì . wǒ xiǎng bù jǐn kàn dǒng wài wén cái liào , hái néng hé tóng xué tǎo lùn zì jǐ de zuò pǐn .
lines.en: Later my teacher asked me to write down what I really wanted to do. I wanted to read material in another language and discuss my work with classmates.

lines.zh: 我发现一门课同时包括这两部分，而且教室离住处只有几百米。教室面积较小，但每个人都能说话。
lines.py: wǒ fā xiàn yī mén kè tóng shí bāo kuò zhè liǎng bù fèn , ér qiě jiào shì lí zhù chù zhǐ yǒu jǐ bǎi mǐ . jiào shì miàn jī jiào xiǎo , dàn měi gè rén dōu néng shuō huà .
lines.en: I found a class covering both parts, with a classroom just a few hundred metres from home. The room was relatively small, but everyone got a chance to speak.

lines.zh: 我于是减少了晚上的课程。两周内，我认识了几位新朋友，也渐渐适应了课堂的节奏。
lines.py: wǒ yú shì jiǎn shǎo le wǎn shang de kè chéng . liǎng zhōu nèi , wǒ rèn shi le jǐ wèi xīn péng you , yě jiàn jiàn shì yìng le kè táng de jié zòu .
lines.en: So I reduced my evening classes. Within two weeks I had met some new friends and gradually adjusted to the pace of class.

lines.zh: 现在我仍然学得很认真，不过周五晚上有时只和朋友散步。能坚持下去的安排，比满满一张表更适合我。
lines.py: xiàn zài wǒ réng rán xué dé hěn rèn zhēn , bù guò zhōu wǔ wǎn shang yǒu shí zhǐ hé péng you sàn bù . néng jiān chí xià qù de ān pái , bǐ mǎn mǎn yī zhāng biǎo gèng shì hé wǒ .
lines.en: I still study seriously, but sometimes on Friday evenings I just walk with friends. A schedule I can maintain suits me better than a completely full timetable.

choices: Fewer classes, with more time to adapt and socialize

lines.zh: 今晚又上课？
lines.py: jīn wǎn yòu shàng kè ?
lines.en: Class again tonight?
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 不上。我终于有空一起吃饭了。
lines.py: bù shàng . wǒ zhōng yú yǒu kōng yì qǐ chī fàn le .
lines.en: No. I finally have time to have dinner with you.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 真难得。你上个月不是上课就是写作业。
lines.py: zhēn nán dé . nǐ shàng gè yuè bù shì shàng kè jiù shì xiě zuò yè .
lines.en: What a rare occasion! Last month you were always either in class or doing homework.
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 我少选了一门。学习不是把日历填满就行。
lines.py: wǒ shǎo xuǎn le yī mén . xué xí bù shì bǎ rì lì tián mǎn jiù xíng .
lines.en: I dropped one class. Filling my calendar isn't all there is to learning.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 那太好了。你选饭馆，我请客。
lines.py: nà tài hǎo le . nǐ xuǎn fàn guǎn , wǒ qǐng kè .
lines.en: Great. You choose the restaurant; dinner's on me.
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 等等，选课我想了两周，选饭馆你给我几分钟？
lines.py: děng děng , xuǎn kè wǒ xiǎng le liǎng zhōu , xuǎn fàn guǎn nǐ gěi wǒ jǐ fēn zhōng ?
lines.en: Wait. I spent two weeks choosing a class. How many minutes do I get to choose a restaurant?
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 她把语言学习和设计结合起来。
lines.py: tā bǎ yǔ yán xué xí hé shè jì jié hé qǐ lái .
lines.en: She combines language study and design.

lines.zh: 我想和不同专业的同学交流。
lines.py: wǒ xiǎng hé bù tóng zhuān yè de tóng xué jiāo liú .
lines.en: I'd like to talk with students in different subjects.

lines.zh: 我姐姐去年去北京留学了。
lines.py: wǒ jiě jie qù nián qù běi jīng liú xué le .
lines.en: My sister went to study in Beijing last year.

lines.zh: 学费可以分两次交。
lines.py: xué fèi kě yǐ fēn liǎng cì jiāo .
lines.en: Tuition can be paid in two instalments.

lines.zh: 他每天读半小时外文报纸。
lines.py: tā měi tiān dú bàn xiǎo shí wài wén bào zhǐ .
lines.en: He reads a foreign-language newspaper for half an hour every day.

lines.zh: 中文系的办公室在三楼。
lines.py: zhōng wén xì de bàn gōng shì zài sān lóu .
lines.en: The Chinese department's office is on the third floor.

lines.zh: 你的专业是设计还是中文？
lines.py: nǐ de zhuān yè shì shè jì hái shi zhōng wén ?
lines.en: Is your subject design or Chinese?

lines.zh: 请到会议室等我。
lines.py: qǐng dào huì yì shì děng wǒ .
lines.en: Please wait for me in the meeting room.

lines.zh: 这所学校有五百名学生。
lines.py: zhè suǒ xué xiào yǒu wǔ bǎi míng xué sheng .
lines.en: This school has five hundred students.

lines.zh: 所长今天不在办公室。
lines.py: suǒ zhǎng jīn tiān bù zài bàn gōng shì .
lines.en: The institute director is not in the office today.

lines.zh: 她很快适应了这里的生活。
lines.py: tā hěn kuài shì yìng le zhè lǐ de shēng huó .
lines.en: She quickly adjusted to life here.

lines.zh: 这个房间的光线较好。
lines.py: zhè gè fáng jiān de guāng xiàn jiào hǎo .
lines.en: This room has comparatively good light.

lines.zh: 选这门课的学生中，女生的比例较高。
lines.py: xuǎn zhè mén kè de xué sheng zhōng , nǚ shēng de bǐ lì jiào gāo .
lines.en: A relatively high proportion of the students choosing this class are women.

lines.zh: 房间面积不大，但住起来很舒服。
lines.py: fáng jiān miàn jī bù dà , dàn zhù qǐ lái hěn shū fú .
lines.en: The room has a small area but is comfortable to live in.

lines.zh: 先向北走两百米，再向右转。
lines.py: xiān xiàng běi zǒu liǎng bǎi mǐ , zài xiàng yòu zhuǎn .
lines.en: Go north two hundred metres, then turn right.

lines.zh: 请在三天内给我回复。
lines.py: qǐng zài sān tiān nèi gěi wǒ huí fù .
lines.en: Please reply within three days.

lines.zh: 这些人当中，有几个是我的老朋友。
lines.py: zhè xiē rén dāng zhōng , yǒu jǐ gè shì wǒ de lǎo péng yǒu .
lines.en: Several people among this group are old friends of mine.

lines.zh: 你周五有空儿吗？
lines.py: nǐ zhōu wǔ yǒu kòngr ma ?
lines.en: Are you free on Friday?

lines.zh: 那位老太太经常坐在这里看书。
lines.py: nà wèi lǎo tài tài jīng cháng zuò zài zhè lǐ kàn shū .
lines.en: That elderly woman often sits here reading.

lines.zh: 我爷爷笑着说，他就是一个爱唱歌的老头儿。
lines.py: wǒ yé ye xiào zhe shuō , tā jiù shì yī gè ài chàng gē de lǎo tou er .
lines.en: My grandpa laughs and says he's just an old man who loves singing.

lines.zh: 这条路方便了附近的老百姓。
lines.py: zhè tiáo lù fāng biàn le fù jìn de lǎo bǎi xìng .
lines.en: This road made life easier for ordinary people nearby.

lines.zh: 每个公民都有自己的权利和义务。
lines.py: měi gè gōng mín dōu yǒu zì jǐ de quán lì hé yì wù .
lines.en: Every citizen has rights and responsibilities.

lines.zh: 所长今天不在，明天才回来。
lines.py: suǒ zhǎng jīn tiān bù zài , míng tiān cái huí lái .
lines.en: The institute director is away today and returns tomorrow.

lines.zh: 这张地图的比例不对，学校看起来比城市还大。
lines.py: zhè zhāng dì tú de bǐ lì bú duì , xué xiào kàn qǐ lái bǐ chéng shì hái dà .
lines.en: The scale of this map is wrong; the school looks bigger than the city.

lines.zh: 我们当中有三个人会开车。
lines.py: wǒ men dāng zhōng yǒu sān gè rén huì kāi chē .
lines.en: Three of us can drive.

lines.zh: 周五有空儿的话，一起吃饭吧。
lines.py: zhōu wǔ yǒu kòngr de huà , yì qǐ chī fàn ba .
lines.en: If you have some free time on Friday, let’s have dinner.

lines.zh: 门口那位老太太是我邻居。
lines.py: mén kǒu nà wèi lǎo tài tài shì wǒ lín jū .
lines.en: The elderly lady at the door is my neighbour.

lines.zh: 那个老头儿每天都来这里喝茶。
lines.py: nà gè lǎo tou er měi tiān dōu lái zhè lǐ hē chá .
lines.en: That old man comes here for tea every day.

lines.zh: 老百姓买菜比以前方便多了。
lines.py: lǎo bǎi xìng mǎi cài bǐ yǐ qián fāng biàn duō le .
lines.en: Buying groceries is much more convenient for ordinary people now.

lines.zh: 每个公民都有自己的权利，也有义务。
lines.py: měi gè gōng mín dōu yǒu zì jǐ de quán lì , yě yǒu yì wù .
lines.en: Every citizen has rights as well as responsibilities.

audio.zh: 差不多了。现在最难的是选专业。
audio.py: chà bu duō le . xiàn zài zuì nán de shì xuǎn zhuān yè .
audio.en: Almost. The hardest part now is choosing a subject.

tasks.statement: The speaker’s hardest task is finding a restaurant.
tasks.why: The speaker says choosing a subject is hardest.

audio.zh: 到新的学校以后，我本来想把每个晚上都安排成学习时间。周一和周三上中文课，周二和周四去设计室，周五参加交流活动。
audio.py: dào xīn de xué xiào yǐ hòu , wǒ běn lái xiǎng bǎ měi gè wǎn shang dōu ān pái chéng xué xí shí jiān . zhōu yī hé zhōu sān shàng zhōng wén kè , zhōu èr hé zhōu sì qù shè jì shì , zhōu wǔ cān jiā jiāo liú huó dòng .
audio.en: When I arrived at my new school, I initially planned to study every evening: Chinese on Mondays and Wednesdays, the design studio on Tuesdays and Thursdays, and an exchange event on Fridays.

tasks.statement: The narrator planned classes or activities every evening.

prompt.py: nǐ xiǎng xiān shǎo xuǎn yī diǎn kè ma ?
prompt.en: Do you want to take fewer classes at first?

tasks.why: The speaker explicitly wants time to adapt.

prompt.py: xué fèi huì zēng jiā ma ?

tasks.why: The proposed arrangement does not increase tuition.

natural.py: wǒ xiǎng xiān shǎo xuǎn yī mén .
natural.en: I'd like to take one fewer class at first.

pragmatics.note: 少选一门 means one fewer course; 少选一点 leaves the amount open.

natural.py: nà wèi lǎo rén xū yào bāng máng ma ?
natural.en: Does that older person need help?

pragmatics.note: 老人 is a safer neutral reference to a stranger. 老头儿 can be familiar, self-deprecating or dismissive depending on the relationship.

conversation.title: More than one good option
conversation.goal: Compare two courses using 不仅…还…

turns.meaning: What would you like to study?
examples: 我想学中文，也想学设计。

turns.text: 为什么不把每天都安排满？
turns.pinyin: wèi shén me bù bǎ měi tiān dōu ān pái mǎn ?
examples: 我想留一点时间和同学交流。
accept: ^我想留一点时间和同学交流。[。！？]?$

notes:
AI-assisted draft; native review pending. GF2021 grammar families: 三66, 三67. Native check: paired alternatives, 不光 register, 老太太/老头儿 politeness, 所 classifier/institution, 系 department, area/proportion scope. No actual eligibility, legal status or study recommendation. Native review pending. Planned retrieval 三49 / 三75 / 三61 / 三62: 她笑得很开心。, 她一点儿也不生气。, 我一会儿读，一会儿听。, 一方面想参加，另一方面需要休息。.
2026-10-07 parity editorial review: Course-choice scene: 不仅/还 and 不是/就是 used conversationally; tuition, area and distance facts checked. Elders’ labels kept contextual rather than generic address. Native check: 所长 context and 老头儿 self-reference. Native review pending; no independent pronunciation or learner-mastery certification.
